summary: Tyler Technologies issued $1.4375B aggregate principal amount of 0.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, with an additional $187.5M from full exercise of the initial purchasers' option. The notes are unsecured, pay semi-annual interest, and mature July 15, 2031. Conversion may occur upon specified events before April 15, 2031, and at any time thereafter; settlement may be cash or a cash/stock combination. No specific use of proceeds is stated, but the filing signals a capital-return or opportunistic financing event. Watch for share dilution if conversion value exceeds par and the company elects stock settlement.
